effective_reserves: actual spendable minus protocol/fund/creator liabilities; do not subtract withholding twice
capital_adjusted_comparison: q^2*K_now*L0^2*D >= q0^2*K0*L_now^2*N, exact product of separately measured nonfee capital normalization factors N/D
CPMM_withdraw_floor_residual: each rational residual>=0 and<1 raw base unit; not an entitlement tolerance
unknown_claim_formula: Explicitly UNPROVEN until actual native evidence justifies applicable measurements; no permanent-protection or hidden-power-absence claim
failed_TX_exception: Only actual transaction network fee, not metadata/create/rent/program charges
